Basics

Unsalted stock

Sózatlan alaplé

6 months+ Adjusted 90 min 10 portions

From 6 months, only inside another suitable dish. A bought stock cube does not replace this, because those cubes are salt.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • about 300 g chicken wings or a small carcass (optional; leave out for a vegetable stock)
  • 1 carrot (scrubbed and chopped)
  • 1 onion (peeled and halved)
  • a few parsley stems (no celery)
  • 1 litre water (no salt and no stock cube)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Put chicken in a pot, or use only the vegetables for a meat-free stock.
  2. Add the carrot, onion, parsley, and water.
  3. Simmer with no salt until the liquid tastes mildly savoury and any chicken is cooked through.
  4. Strain out the bones and the spent vegetables.
  5. Cool quickly and freeze the liquid in an ice tray.
  6. Use a frozen portion in cooking, not as a bowl of soup on its own.

Adjusted

Stock cubes are salt.

Simmer chicken or vegetables with no salt, strain the liquid, and freeze it in small portions. Use it as an ingredient, not as a meal.
